transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hi, doctor. I just can’t seem to slow down—I’m constantly taking on new projects and working nonstop, like I’m stuck in overdrive. It feels like I can't find a pause button no matter how hard I try.
Do you often feel irritable, anxious, or extremely happy when you're working on these projects or is it more about just keeping busy all the time?

It’s definitely a mix of both. I often feel on top of the world and highly driven, with my mind and body stuck in high gear constantly pushing me to start new projects. But I also get extremely irritable and snap at my wife or my crew over the smallest things because I feel like they're just slowing down my big plans.
Can you tell me more about these episodes of feeling 'on top of the world' - how long do they typically last and do you experience any periods of feeling extremely low or depressed afterwards?

This whole overdrive feeling has actually been continuous and intense for about seven months now. I haven't really had any of those extreme lows or depressed crashes afterwards; it's just been this ongoing, non-stop high energy.
Have you noticed any periods where your high energy and driven state shifts, even briefly, to feeling sad, empty, or hopeless, or does it remain consistently elevated?

No, I haven't felt sad, empty, or hopeless at all; my energy has stayed consistently high and in overdrive this whole time. Instead of crashing, my mood just swings between feeling on top of the world and getting extremely irritable and snapping at my wife or my crew when I feel like they're slowing down my plans.
Have you engaged in any impulsive behaviors, such as excessive spending, reckless driving, or impulsive decisions, during these periods of high energy and feeling 'on top of the world'?

Yes, I've made some really impulsive financial decisions. I bought a bunch of expensive tools and solar inventory on credit for a business that doesn't even exist yet, which has run up major debts and made my wife furious. At the time, I felt so confident in my big plans that it seemed completely justified to me.
Have you experienced any distractibility or difficulty focusing on one task for an extended period, or do you find you can hyper-focus on your projects despite the constant stream of new ideas?

I'm definitely extremely distractible rather than hyper-focused. When I try to focus on wiring or studying, every little thing like a buzzing phone, a humming light, or a new idea completely pulls my attention away. I end up dropping tasks halfway through to start something else, leaving behind a mess of unfinished projects.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, such as difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep, due to your racing thoughts or high energy levels?

Yes, my sleep has dropped dramatically—most nights I only lie down for two or three hours because my mind is constantly racing with wiring diagrams and business plans. I don't even feel tired, just completely wired and ready to keep working. Honestly, sleeping feels like a total waste of time when I have so much to get done.
Can you tell me if you've experienced these symptoms of high energy, distractibility, and impulsive decisions consistently throughout your life, or if this is a relatively new development for you?

No, this isn't a lifelong thing at all; it's a relatively new development for me. This intense overdrive has been building and staying constant for about the last seven months, ever since I took on a big commercial solar contract and started studying nights for my Master Electrician exam.

You mentioned this intense overdrive has been constant for about seven months, but can you tell me if there was a specific event or period that triggered this change, or if it seemed to come on gradually over time?

It definitely came on gradually, building up over the last seven months. It started right around the time I took on a massive double workload—studying late at night for my Master Electrician exam while working overtime on a big commercial solar contract. As those projects grew, this overdrive just ramped up and stayed intense.

You've mentioned that this intense overdrive has been constant for about seven months, but can you clarify if you've had any periods where these symptoms significantly worsened or improved in response to specific events, such as completing a major project or experiencing a personal setback?

I haven't really noticed any clear ups or downs or periods where things got better. It's just felt like a continuous, steady build-up of intense energy over the whole seven months without any real breaks. No matter what was happening with work or at home, the overdrive just stayed constant.
Can you describe how your relationships, work performance, or daily life have been affected by this constant overdrive and high energy state over the past seven months?

It’s been really rough—my boss actually pulled me off field work because clients complained about my chaotic scheduling, and my crew didn't feel safe with my fast-paced decisions. At home, my wife is furious about the massive credit card debts I ran up buying tools and solar inventory, and she says I'm never present anymore since I stopped going to family barbecues and softball just to work on my projects.

You mentioned that this intense overdrive started around the time you took on a massive double workload with studying for your Master Electrician exam and working on a big commercial solar contract. Do you think that if you were to complete these projects or significantly reduce your workload, your symptoms of high energy, distractibility, and impulsive decisions would decrease or resolve?

I don't really see these behaviors as "symptoms" that need to be resolved or fixed. This high energy is exactly what I need to achieve my plans, and I have no desire to slow down because I am on the verge of building something huge. My wife and my boss just don't understand how big this is going to be yet.

Have you experienced any significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other areas of functioning as a result of your high energy and impulsive behaviors, or do you primarily see these traits as beneficial to your goals and aspirations?

Even though everything is currently in chaos—my boss pulled me off field work because clients complained and the crew felt unsafe, and my wife is furious about the debts and me missing family events—I still feel like this drive is necessary. I honestly believe I'm meant to revolutionize the local solar industry with my ideas, and I've felt like they will all end up thanking me once they see how big this business actually becomes.

Can you describe any instances where your high energy and impulsive behaviors led to marked impairment in social or occupational functioning, or were they generally seen as goal-oriented and productive, despite causing chaos?

While I initially felt highly productive and driven, it has definitely crossed the line into causing serious impairment. At work, my boss pulled me off field work because clients complained and my crew felt unsafe with my fast timelines, and at home, my wife is furious about the debts I ran up and the fact that I've stopped attending family barbecues and am never present.

Can you think of any situations or periods where your high energy and driven state did not lead to impairment in your relationships or work, but instead was seen as beneficial or productive by those around you?

Yes, at the very beginning of this seven-month stretch, my family actually appreciated my extra drive and the long hours I spent in the garage planning a future family-run business. It initially seemed highly productive and exciting to everyone, right before it escalated and started causing all the current strain and problems.

Can you clarify if there was ever a distinct period, even if brief, where you felt extremely high, irritable, or had decreased need for sleep, that lasted for at least one week and was not solely explained by your work or study schedule?

Yes, this entire seven-month stretch has been a continuous period of feeling on top of the world and highly irritable, where I've only needed two or three hours of sleep a night without feeling tired. While it started around the time of my busy work and study schedule, this extreme energy and constant racing mind feel way more intense than just being busy. It's definitely been a distinct, nonstop state that goes far beyond normal stress.

Can you confirm if, despite the constant high energy and irritability, you've experienced any brief periods of normal mood or significant reduction in your symptoms over the past seven months, or has it been a continuous, unbroken stretch of this intense state?

It has been a completely continuous, unbroken stretch of this intense energy for the entire seven months, without any breaks or periods of normal mood. I've felt constantly 'on' and stuck in high gear the entire time since I started the solar contract and studying at night. There hasn't been a single day where I've slowed down or felt back to normal.

Have you ever experienced a distinct period of at least two weeks where you felt abnormally low or depressed, or has your mood consistently been high and irritable without significant lows over the past year?

No, I haven't experienced any low or depressed periods at all. For the last seven months, my mood has been consistently high, wired, and irritable, and I've just felt stuck in overdrive without any significant lows.

You've had this continuous high energy state for seven months without any significant lows, but can you think of any past instances in your life before this period where you experienced similar episodes of high energy and irritability, or has this been a completely new development for you?

No, this is a completely new development for me—I’ve never experienced anything remotely like this before in my life. Before this past seven-month stretch when I took on the solar contract and started studying for my Master Electrician exam, my energy levels were completely normal. This intense overdrive is a whole new level of energy that I've never had until now.

Can you confirm if you have experienced any periods of significant mood elevation or irritability prior to the past seven months that lasted for at least four consecutive days, or has this been the first time you've experienced such a prolonged state of high energy and irritability?

I can definitely confirm that this is the absolute first time I've ever experienced anything like this. Before these past seven months, I never had any periods of intense high energy, racing thoughts, or irritability that lasted for days. This whole "overdrive" state is completely new to me.

Have you ever had a period where your mood shifted back to normal for a few days or a week, only to return to this high energy state, or has it been a completely consistent high energy state without any breaks?

No, there haven't been any breaks or normal periods at all; it has been a completely consistent, non-stop high-energy state. This overdrive has been building and staying intense continuously for the last seven months, ever since I started studying for the Master Electrician exam and took on that big solar contract. I've just been stuck in this high gear the entire time.
Have you experienced any periods where you felt extremely low or hopeless after a period of feeling 'on top of the world', or has your mood remained consistently elevated without significant lows?

No, I haven't had any crashes or periods of feeling low or hopeless at all. My mood has stayed consistently in overdrive for the past seven months, swinging between feeling on top of the world and getting easily irritated. I've just been constantly wound up without any of those low periods during this whole stretch.

Can you describe if there have been any periods, even brief, where you felt your high energy and mood elevation were not under your control, or if you've always felt like you could manage or stop these feelings if you wanted to?

It definitely feels completely out of my control, like my brain and body are permanently stuck in high gear. Even though I initially felt on top of the world and ignored everyone's warnings because I was so convinced of my big plans, I've realized I actually can't slow down or turn this off, no matter how hard I try. I just can't find a way to pause it anymore.

Do you feel like you're able to intentionally bring yourself down from these high-energy states or stop the racing thoughts when you want to, or do you feel like it's something that happens to you without your control?

It's completely out of my control, like something that just happens to me. Even when I try to lie down and sleep, my mind just keeps racing with wiring diagrams and business plans that I can't turn off. I'm stuck in high gear and can't slow myself down, even if I wanted to.

Have you ever had a period where you felt like you were able to intentionally calm down or reduce your high energy state, or does it always feel like it's something that happens to you without your ability to control it?

No, I've never been able to intentionally calm it down; it always feels like it's happening to me without any control. My mind and body are constantly wired, making it impossible to just switch off even when my wife or boss tells me to. I'm just stuck in high gear and can't slow down.

Have you ever experienced a distinct period where your mood and energy levels seemed to switch or cycle between extremely high and low, or has it consistently been this continuous high-energy state without significant lows?

It has consistently been this continuous high-energy state for the entire seven months, without any cycling or low periods at all. This is actually the first time in my life I've ever experienced an episode like this, and it's just been ongoing high gear and irritability.

Have you ever had a period in your life where you experienced a clear shift or cycling between episodes of high energy and episodes of depression or low mood, or has your mood always been relatively stable before this current episode?

My mood and energy were completely stable before this, and I've never had any periods of depression or other high-energy episodes in the past. This is the absolute first time I've ever experienced anything like this. It all only started about seven months ago when I began studying for my exam and took on that big solar contract.

Have you ever had a distinct period where you felt a noticeable shift from your current high-energy state to a low or depressed mood, or has your mood remained consistently elevated without any significant shifts?

No, I haven't experienced any shifts to a low or depressed mood at all. My energy and mood have just stayed consistently high and stuck in overdrive for the entire seven months. There hasn't been any crash or low period during this whole time.

Can you confirm if you have ever experienced a distinct period of at least two weeks where you felt abnormally low or depressed at any point in your life before this seven-month period of high energy?

No, I don't recall ever having a period like that in my past where I felt abnormally low or depressed for two weeks or more. Before this seven-month stretch of overdrive, my mood and energy were always pretty stable. I've just never experienced those kinds of deep lows.

Can you clarify if there was a specific point or period within the last seven months where your high energy and mood elevation were at their peak, or has it been a relatively consistent level of intensity throughout?

Once it fully ramped up, it has been a pretty consistent level of intensity the whole time. It started building about seven months ago when I took on the solar contract and exam prep, and since then I've just stayed stuck in high gear without any specific peaks or drops.
